# Pass page fixtures

`pass_page_badges_fhd.png` comes from the 2026-10-13 live 1080p recording
`story_08_pass_claim_all_daily_live_1013_154246.mp4`, first second. Only
`PASS_BADGE_STRIP` (the card badges, y 288 and 394) and `PASS_TAB_BADGE_STRIP`
(the 任务 tab badge, y 658) are kept; every other pixel is black.

`character_pass_reward_tab_fhd.png` and `character_pass_mission_tab_fhd.png`
come from Leo's 4K desktop clone on 2026-10-26 (1920x1080 game, 简中),
opened read-only on 毁灭之星艾瑞克角色通行证, the pass a player reported as
never claimed. Only the two badge strips and `PASS_CLAIM_BUTTON` are kept.
On the reward (star) tab 全部获得 is grey and the 任务 tab carries a red ◆!;
on the 任务 tab 全部获得 is lit (three finished missions).
